source: DuckDuckGo image search, 673 searches in two sweeps (every SRK film from Deewana to KING: stills, songs, behind the scenes, first looks; events, birthdays and Eid at Mannat year by year; Filmfare and IIFA year by year; 36 magazines; co-stars; KKR season by season; photoshoots; throwbacks; Hindi, Urdu and Bengali searches). Each picture is shown from the page that published it and links back to that page; nothing is stored on this site. Pictures under 400 px, duplicates and stock-photo watermark sites left out.
